title: Binary value of a Boolean sequence
statement: For an infinite Boolean sequence $p$, define its binary value by the convergent series $\sum_{i=0}^{\infty} \mathbf{1}_{\{p_i=\mathrm{true}\}}/2^{i+1}$, where the indicator is $1$ when the indexed bit is true and $0$ otherwise.
